authority: posthoc Development on a consumed source; not fresh confirmation
objective: Test whether one explicitly independent geometry slot can recover a clipped portal whose detector and SAM extents absorb a nearer lower occluder, while retaining a maximum of three final hypotheses.

requirements: same class-conditioned door prompt in both views
same left or right image border touched in both views
valid sustained post-plane depth drop in both views
selection.order: highest 3D track score, then pair depth score, then original rank

claim_boundary: A positive result is a consumed-source Development mechanism result for referent-region hypothesis recovery only. It is not source-disjoint confirmation and does not establish portal ownership, affordance, waypoint, arrival, safety, or handoff.
